from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class Document(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its assigned cause category."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as named in the text")
    cause_category: Literal[
        '物权保护纠纷',
        '民间借贷纠纷',
        '产品责任纠纷',
        '行政主体-劳动和社会保障行政管理（劳动，社会保障）',
        '与公司，证券，保险，票据等有关的民事纠纷',
        '行政主体-房屋拆迁管理（拆迁）'
    ] = Field(description="The cause of action category assigned to this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document] = Field(description="List of all processed judgment documents")
